## Answer: Highest growth phase = 15th–14th centuries BCE (1500–1301 BCE), सबसे तेज़ 15वीं सदी (1500–1401 BCE)

### Century-wise ranking table (2000–1100 BCE; bins by start BCE, e.g. "1500" = 1500–1401 BCE)

| Century bin | mean g_all_mean | mean pollen_grate_100 | rank_g | rank_p | rank_avg | KDE level chg into bin | pollen_inter_100 chg into bin | SMOOTH_MEAN_100y chg into bin | Z-indicators positive (of 12) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **1500 (1500–1401 BCE)** | **0.00283** | **0.00189** | 1 | 1 | **1.0** | +0.000062 | −0.60 | −0.59 | 7 |
| **1400 (1400–1301 BCE)** | **0.00145** | **0.00111** | 2 | 2 | **2.0** | **+0.000087** | **+1.13** | **+1.37** | 6 |
| 1900 | 0.00028 | 0.00017 | 4 | 4 | 4.0 | 0.00000 | −0.26 | −0.01 | 3 |
| 1700 | 0.00005 | 0.00086 | 6 | 3 | 4.5 | −0.00000 | −0.19 | −0.87 | 5 |
| 2000 | 0.00006 | −0.00090 | 5 | 7 | 6.0 | – | – | – | – |
| 1800 | −0.00007 | −0.00024 | 7 | 6 | 6.5 | 0.00000 | +0.51 | +0.45 | 8 |
| 1600 | 0.00115 | −0.00301 | 3 | 10 | 6.5 | +0.00001 | −0.57 | −1.09 | 3 |
| 1300 | −0.00155 | −0.00017 | 8 | 5 | 6.5 | −0.00000 | +0.56 | +1.10 | 1 |
| 1200 | −0.00437 | −0.00104 | 9 | 8 | 8.5 | −0.00010 | −0.66 | −0.86 | 2 |
| 1100 (single year) | −0.00053* | −0.00256 | 10 | 9 | 9.5 | – | – | – | – |

### Top centuries per metric (disagreements साफ़ रूप में)
- **g_all_mean (KDE growth rate)**: 1500s > 1400s > 1600s BCE
- **pollen_grate_100 (%-change openness)**: 1500s > 1400s > 1700s BCE
- **Composite rank-average**: 1500s (1.0), 1400s (2.0) — दोनों primary metrics सहमत, कोई disagreement नहीं
- **Secondary level-based change (into century)**: KDE level → 1400s; pollen_inter_100 → 1400s (+1.13); SMOOTH_MEAN_100y → 1400s (+1.37), फिर 1300s (+1.10)। यानी rate 15वीं सदी में peak पर, और openness का level स्तर 14वीं सदी में सबसे तेज़ चढ़ा।
- **Tertiary Z cross-check (capital.csv, absolute century change)**: 1800s (8/12 positive), 1500s (7/12), 1400s (6/12); mean absolute Z-change सबसे बड़ा 1400s (+0.68) में।

### Sensitivity checks
(a) **Rolling 100-year windows**: top windows by g_all_mean केंद्रित ~1449, ~1400, ~1500, ~1350 BCE; pollen_grate_100 top ~1400, ~1450 BCE → century-bin result (1500–1301 BCE peak) से पूरी तरह संगत।
(b) **Adjacent-century distinguishability (g_all_mean, SE से)**: 1500s vs 1400s z = 6.35; 1500s vs 1300s z = 19.5; pollen rate 1500s vs 1400s z = 3.27 → smoothing artifact नहीं; 15वीं सदी का lead सांख्यिकीय रूप से स्पष्ट है।
(c) **1100 BCE boundary**: वह bin single-year है; उसे हटाने पर भी top-2 वही (1500s, 1400s)।

### Final hypothesis (natural language)
"2000–1100 BCE की अवधि में highest growth phase 15वीं और 14वीं शताब्दी ईसा पूर्व (लगभग 1500–1301 BCE), विशेष रूप से 1500–1400 BCE में थी। यह निष्कर्ष दो स्वतंत्र dataset-provided growth-rate indicators पर आधारित है — aggregate KDE growth rate (g_all_mean) और 100-yr-smoothed pollen openness score का percentage change (pollen_grate_100) — जिन दोनों में 1500–1401 BCE सबसे ऊँचा धनात्मक growth दर्शाता है और 1400–1301 BCE दूसरे क्रम पर है। Level-based संकेत (KDE density व pollen openness का century-to-century increase) 14वीं सदी में सबसे बड़ा increase दिखाते हैं, अर्थात् growth की गति 15वीं सदी में चरम पर थी और उसका स्तरीय प्रभाव (openness में उछाल) 14वीं सदी में सबसे स्पष्ट है; इसी बीच capital-indicator Z-values (1400s में 12 में से 6, 1500s में 7 positive) भी उसी विंडो का समर्थन करते हैं। इसके बाद 13वीं–12वीं सदी ईसा पूर्व में growth ऋणात्मक हो जाती है (दोनों rate metrics में न्यूनतम 1200–1101 BCE)। यह मान्यता पर आधारित है कि pollen PC1 openness एक demographic/human-impact proxy है (higher openness = अधिक मानवीय प्रभाव), जो study context से दिया गया assumption है।"

### Limitations
- Raw annual Z/pollen columns window में ~99% NaN हैं; विश्लेषण dataset के interpolated/smoothed columns पर आधारित है।
- g_all_mean का absolute scale छोटा है; ranking relative है।
- 1100 BCE bin single-year है (ranking पर कोई प्रभाव नहीं, sensitivity-verified)।
- Z cross-check में 1800s का n_z_pos (8/12) थोड़ा ऊँचा है, पर उसकी magnitude और दोनों primary rates मामूली हैं — composite ranking इसे top नहीं लाती।

Executed script: analysis/growth_analysis_final.py (output: analysis/output.txt); main table की पुनरुत्पादन-जाँच की गई।

payload.hypothesis: The highest growth phase between 2000 BCE and 1100 BCE occurred in the 15th–14th centuries BCE (~1500–1301 BCE), with the fastest growth in 1500–1400 BCE. Both dataset-provided growth-rate indicators — aggregate KDE growth rate (g_all_mean) and the percentage change of the 100-year-smoothed pollen openness score (pollen_grate_100) — peak in the 15th century BCE (1500–1401 BCE), with the 14th century BCE (1400–1301 BCE) second; level-based increases in KDE density and pollen openness are largest in the 14th century BCE, and capital-indicator Z-value changes support the same window. Growth turns negative by the 13th–12th centuries BCE (minimum 1200–1101 BCE). Assumes pollen PC1 openness is a demographic/human-impact proxy (higher openness = more human impact).
payload.workflow: Loaded the three staged CSVs (comma-decimal parsing for capital/pollen files); aligned all on annual CE (calBP = 1950 − CE verified); filtered 2000–1100 BCE (901 rows); computed century-bin means of primary rate columns g_all_mean and pollen_grate_100 plus their rank-average; computed century-to-century absolute level changes for kde_all_mean, pollen_inter_100, SMOOTH_MEAN_100y (secondary) and for capital.csv Z-indicators (tertiary, absolute change only, no % change); ran sensitivity checks: 100-year rolling windows (step 50), adjacent-century peak distinguishability using g_all_std standard errors, and exclusion of the single-year 1100 BCE boundary bin. Script: analysis/growth_analysis_final.py; output: analysis/output.txt.
